negatives.failure: default Windows locale could not decode a UTF-8 frozen Git object
negatives.effect: build stopped before any x2 evidence artifact was generated
negatives.recovery: request UTF-8 explicitly from the additive Git wrapper and rerun from the unchanged frozen x1 commit

negatives.failure: the Windows console encoding could not emit the Māori authority boundary in validator JSON
negatives.effect: the validator wrote its result file but returned a console-encoding error
negatives.recovery: configure verifier stdout as UTF-8 and rerun the unchanged evidence packet

negatives.failure: the replay test omitted the valid pending_clean_snapshots pre-commit state
negatives.effect: one of 20 phase tests failed while the full and minimal validators remained valid
negatives.recovery: admit the exact builder-emitted pending state without weakening the verified-state requirement

negatives.failure: PowerShell rejected a combined privacy-help and stale-label command because of malformed quoting
negatives.effect: neither audit result from that invocation was accepted as evidence
negatives.recovery: split the read-only audits into simpler commands and rerun each from the unchanged worktree

negatives.failure: an inherited v641-v4 test could not write or clean mode-0700 temporary directories in either the system or Tamar-owned D-drive temp root
negatives.effect: two 190-test reruns ended with one environmental error each after an earlier complete pass
negatives.diagnosis: ordinary inherited-ACL child directories were writable; the failure followed Python 3.12 tempfile mode 0700 under the managed Windows execution token
negatives.recovery: use the additive family test runner to create only ephemeral temp children with inherited parent ACLs; do not edit the inherited test or change parent or host security

negatives.failure: the first adapted runner omitted the repository from sys.path; the second incorrectly treated the bare tests directory as an importable package
negatives.effect: the first ran only 106 tests with six import errors; the second stopped before discovery; both partial results were rejected
negatives.recovery: insert the repository in sys.path while preserving bare unittest discovery from tests
